method: Derived from widened OSM asphalt, subtracting effective OSM/Overture buildings and protected open space. INEGI blocks are statistical reference, not sidewalk boundaries. All widths, furniture positions and model dimensions are artistic estimates. OSM footway evidence retained separately; no surveyed pavement accuracy asserted.
